_note: DP1 supplementary (fine-grained) rating bands. The COMMON stars in qa-evaluation-criteria.md are unchanged and still reported; this file only subdivides each star band so that candidates inside the same common star can be told apart. Edges are inclusive-lower. Any change after a result was produced must be logged as a new rating version (see Evaluation/DP1/qa-criteria-dp1.md).

version_history.dp1-rating-v2: QA3 official star = delta of useful HBM utilization vs Baseline in pp, edges -5/+15 pp (qa3_delta_pp_edges_v2). Kept for the record.
version_history.dp1-rating-v3: QA3 v4 definition (pooled occupancy over ALL memories x SLO ratio x (1 - migration link fraction)); official star = RELATIVE improvement U_cand/U_base with edges 0.95/1.25 = the QA2 improvement-factor edges, chosen by analogy BEFORE the v4 numbers were seen. Definition change itself is defined_after_first_look (the v2/v3 star was already seen).

dp1_star._note: DP1 official star rule (3-star scale kept). Relative to the DP1 Common Reference Baseline (Baseline-static). Common stars are still reported next to it for cross-DP comparability. Edges inclusive-lower.
dp1_star.qa3_relative_edges_note: Same values as qa2_latency_improvement_edges (a ratio-to-Baseline where >1 is better, 'noticeable improvement' = 25%). Fixed by analogy before the v4 numbers were computed. NOT tuned to the outcome (evaluation H16).
